mu_name_from: _enum.h:1543 MODEL_CRYSTAL_SWORD = MODEL_MACE + 5, loaded from Item/Mace06.bmd; OpenMU Version075 Items/Weapons.cs:121 names group 2, index 5 the Crystal Sword.
why_this_one: Drop level 72: Blood Castle 3's monsters (56-79) reach it, and it was one of the three pieces of gear in that window not built (the user, 2026-10-03: 'Build the six missing items ... then the four drops').

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Weapons.cs:121. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: CreateWeapon(group, number, slot, skillNumber, width, height, dropsFromMonsters, name, dropLevel, minimumDamage, maximumDamage, attackSpeed, durability, magicPower, levelRequirement, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, energyRequirement, vitalityRequirement, wizardClass, knightClass, elfClass).
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are the wizard, knight and elf flags, all three set, as the Crystal Morning Star's.

stance_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:356-368: a sword, axe or mace that is TwoHand (width 2) stands PLAYER_STOP_TWO_HAND_SWORD. As Mace05.
two_handed_from: Width 2 in the call; OpenMU's `group < Bows && width == 2` and MuMain's ItemAttribute TwoHand agree.
sheet_from: Data/Item/ni99.OZJ (64x128, a blue crystal blade, spiked, on grey), 192 triangles, the one mesh. Decoded from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
material_overrides_note: As the Crystal Morning Star's; the whole sword is the glow below, so the steel serves the bake only.
glow_note: `case MODEL_CRYSTAL_SWORD`: BlendMesh 0 and no BlendMeshLight (ZzzObject.cpp:5260-5262) -- texture 0, ni99, its one mesh, is drawn added at a steady light: the whole sword is a crystal ghost, as the Bluewing Crossbow is. Drawn added on its raw sheet (export_gltf.glow_material). Not here: the blue swing blur MuMain picks for its fifth skill swing, BlurMapping 1 (ZzzCharacter.cpp:3822-3828), a client effect.
rig_note: No .rig.json: Mace06.bmd has one bone and one action of one key (export-rig --actions=all, 2026-10-03), nothing moves -- MuMain sets it playing action 0 at twice the stand's speed when held (ZzzCharacter.cpp:10120-10123), on a single key.
